column1: # area: drawsim — addresses named while working through docs/issues/draw-sim-leaks.md. Only addresses no other file names.

column3: (force, queryOnly, noCardSave) -> number of options that differ between the live option globals and g_savedConfig; offline it also counts the button maps. Unless queryOnly: when the count is non-zero it copies the live options into g_savedConfig and then rewrites the nine per-slot button-mask arrays 0x41b980..0x41ba30 for all four slots from g_savedButtonMaps, with no network test (loop 0x1e6a60-0x1e6b0c), then requests a config save unless noCardSave. Callers: pauseMenu_task 0x18d180 / 0x18d2c8 / 0x18d2e0, the warpMenu task 0x18e2f8, frontend_run

saved image of the options: +4 float 0x44fd80, +8 music volume, +0xc effects volume, +0x10 0x4f8948, +0x14 0x41bfb0, +0x18 0x4fdcc8, +0x1c 0x44fcf4, +0x20 damage-number option, +0x24 g_decalDetail, +0x28..+0x30 0x4f8458..0x4f8460, +0x34 g_savedButtonMaps, +0xc4..+0xd4 voice options. Compared and refreshed by config_commitOptions

4 rows x 9 words: this machine's controller configuration per local port (attack, ability A, ability B, use, block, potion A, potion B, 0x41b9e0, weapon swap masks); source of net_restoreButtonConfig and of the copy at the end of config_commitOptions
options value tested by FlyingText_draw and, offline only, by damage_apply 0x1ea998

int[4] per slot: bit 0 is ORed in by Player_takeDamage when the damage is above 0 (0x1b5758-0x1b5760) and cleared by hud_drawPlayerStatus, which brightens the health bar for that frame (0x1d9ec4-0x1d9ee8)

int[4][8] per slot: frames left for eight HUD notice lines (for example the low-ammunition lines Player_run starts at 0x1a8890); written by Player_run, Player_usePotion, menu_openInventory, the camera input code and hud_drawPlayerStatus
int[4][8] per slot: screen row given to each notice line when it starts (the result of hud_countActiveNotices)
(slot, except) -> how many of the slot's eight notice timers are running, leaving out index except and some lines hidden by others; used only to place a new line
Inferred: debug pause-menu action (call 0x18dbe8, reached only with g_debugCheats): walks the world with the callbacks pauseDebug_hitObject and pauseDebug_useObject

object callback: for an object without the player flag that passes a class test, calls its take-damage slot with 300.0 from player 0 and, for a creature, its run slot; otherwise its touch slot. Draw-task code calling simulation slots; debug only
